banners_note: STATIC. Each banner is ONE mesh (banner_<colour>_<a..d>.glb): a cloth simulation settled under gravity and a light side wind and baked, 1.6 cm thick, its trim a band of the same faces. One per rod. They are also in `placements`; this list only names them. Do not animate them and do not add others. The awnings' canopies (awning_cloth_*.glb) are made the same way.
water: run_pool_water.glb: one flat sheet per layout pool (all four, pool_2_rocks too), in pr_water, 4 cm UNDER the layout's surface, so a sheet Unity lays at the surface never shares its plane. run_slide_water.glb: the sloping sheet on each slide's bed and the fan it runs out in, in pr_water_running, 5 mm over the collision bed, UV v running downstream in units of 4.6 m.
look: Late morning in a dry bowl, the sun from the south-east at about 40 degrees raking the stepped face: warm key (1.0, 0.89, 0.70), clear deep-blue sky fill, soft long shadows under the arches and in the chasms. Warm sand-coloured distance fog starting about 150 m, thick by 600 m, so the far rock stacks sit pale in the haze. No bloom on the rock; the capiz lanterns and the water may glow a little. Grade toward warm highlights and teal-leaning shadows, as Lagoon Cove's look row, a touch drier.
